scripts.start: bun run sync && bun run build:dashboard && bun scripts/electrobun.ts dev
scripts.build:canary: bun run sync && bun run build:dashboard && bun scripts/electrobun.ts build --env=canary
scripts.build:stable: bun run sync && bun run build:dashboard && bun scripts/electrobun.ts build --env=stable
scripts.build:dashboard: bunx --no-install vite build --config vite.desktop.config.ts && bun scripts/prepare-assets.ts
scripts.build:dev: bun run sync && bun run build:dashboard && bun scripts/electrobun.ts build --env=dev
